instructions.question: Does this change alter runtime behavior, business logic, or observable output (not comments or formatting only)?
instructions.context: Use before/after code, complete changed-file inventory, relevant tests and test-search coverage. Missing supplied context is unknown, not absence of tests.
instructions.focus: Require concrete evidence for this question independently; do not infer it from another answer.
ignore: Absence inferred from a partial patch or omitted tests
A test file name alone as proof of behavioral coverage

true.what: Observable behavior or logic was changed

instructions.question: Given the behavior change visible here, are there no corresponding test file changes in the provided context?
instructions.context: Use before/after code, complete changed-file inventory, relevant tests and test-search coverage. Missing supplied context is unknown, not absence of tests.
instructions.focus: Require an observable behavior/contract change and complete changed-file inventory establishing no corresponding test update. This is a review candidate, not proof existing tests are inadequate.
ignore: Absence inferred from a partial patch or omitted tests
A test file name alone as proof of behavioral coverage

true.what: Behavior changed but no test updates are present in context

false.what: No relevant behavior change, corresponding tests updated, or changed-file inventory incomplete.

instructions.question: Does this module or feature area appear to have no test file at all in the provided context?
instructions.context: Use before/after code, complete changed-file inventory, relevant tests and test-search coverage. Missing supplied context is unknown, not absence of tests.
instructions.focus: Require a recorded search across relevant unit, integration and end-to-end test locations establishing no related test file; missing context alone must remain false.
ignore: Absence inferred from a partial patch or omitted tests
A test file name alone as proof of behavioral coverage

true.what: No test file is evident for this area

false.what: A related test exists or search coverage is incomplete/unknown.
